Subject: Quick recap + procurement next steps for Redwood trial

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we reviewed: low-latency product search reranking using embeddings + reranker, estimated 20–40ms p95 for typical queries on the Dedicated profile we discussed.
- Proposed pilot: 6-week evaluation on a subset of search traffic (5m queries/day), Redwood Dedicated with autoscaled burst for peak shopping hours.
- Proposed metrics to measure: p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, and relevance delta vs current baseline.

Ask / next steps: 
1) If you agree, can you connect me to your procurement contact to kick off vendor onboarding (W-9 / ACH / vendor portal invite)?
2) We attached an initial quote and an SLA summary for procurement to review (Redwood-quote-20260912.pdf, Redwood-SLA-summary.pdf).
3) Marissa will run a short technical onboarding checklist once procurement gives the green light.

If procurement wants a one-page SOW instead, I can produce that by Monday. Is procurement the right owner to loop in now, or should we route through legal first?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to expedite.

—Karthik
